name: @armen181/opencode-planner
description: Planner plugin for OpenCode 2: an opt-in planner agent that delegates to brainstormer/worker/tester subagents (and handles images via a vision subagent or proxy bridge), with a hard subagent concurrency cap, a mandatory-delegation watchdog, global defaults + per-project snapshots, version checks and one-click updates, TUI dialogs, and MCP servers disabled by default.
